title: News post front matter
description: The front matter of a file at news/<year>/<slug>.md, between the two `---` lines. It is YAML, which many editors will not validate from a schema, so the rules here are enforced by the validation script.

title.description: Required. The headline of the article, and what the listing shows above the preview.

author.description: Required. Who wrote it, as it should be credited. There is no fallback to a signature line at the end of the body.

date.description: Required. Publication time. A post is listed from this moment on, and it orders the listing.

updated.description: When the post was last edited. Defaults to `date`.

id.description: Post identifier, and what `GET /news/{news}?key=id` addresses. Derived from `date` to the second when absent, so it stays the same across deployments.

series.description: Reserved for grouping. Unchecked. Expect this to become an enumeration once the set is settled.
